info.title: SignalStack SMS Public API
info.description: Tenant-scoped API for contacts, audiences, dummy-safe messaging, campaigns, conversations, API-key self-management, and signed customer webhooks. Live SMS remains disabled until later standalone milestones.

get.description: The one unauthenticated /api/v1 exception. It returns the raw OpenAPI document rather than a success envelope.

parameters.name: X-SignalStack-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds used in the signature input.

parameters.name: X-SignalStack-Signature
parameters.description: v1=<lowercase hex HMAC-SHA-256(timestamp + '.' + exact raw body)>

429.description: Retries with bounded backoff and Retry-After handling.

BearerAuth.description: A tenant API key returned only at creation or rotation.

CustomerWebhookSignature.name: X-SignalStack-Signature
CustomerWebhookSignature.description: v1 HMAC-SHA-256 signature over the exact timestamp and raw request bytes.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: One valid UUID may be retained for correlation.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Credential-scoped mutation key retained for 24 hours.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque, tenant- and resource-bound HMAC cursor.

XRequestId.description: The request correlation UUID, matching meta.requestId for enveloped responses.

CacheControl.description: Public API responses are not cacheable.

RateLimitLimit.description: The calling key's configured requests per minute.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Non-negative requests remaining in the current database window.

RateLimitReset.description: Current database window reset time as Unix seconds.

RetryAfter.description: Positive seconds until an exhausted key may retry.

Allow.description: Comma-separated methods implemented by the requested route.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: True only when the stored response was replayed.

Error400.description: Invalid request, JSON, cursor, or idempotency evidence.

Error403.description: The API key lacks an exact required scope.

Error404.description: The tenant-scoped resource was not found.

Error413.description: Request payload exceeds the public API limit.

Error415.description: Only application/json is accepted for JSON bodies.

Error422.description: Validation failed or the operation is not allowed.

Error429.description: The PostgreSQL-authoritative API-key rate window is exhausted.

Error503.description: Authentication, rate-limit, tenant, or storage boundary unavailable.

OpenApiDocument.description: The raw OpenAPI 3.1 document; this metadata route is not wrapped in an API envelope.
